items.headline: Netflix reported Q2 2026 results, with EPS beating estimates but Q3 EPS and sales guidance lowered; shares sold off in after-hours trading.
TradingView news flow highlights a Seaport Research upgrade to Buy with a higher price target, alongside commentary on strong engagement for recent titles ahead of earnings.
Market commentary says Netflix is under pressure after its latest earnings update because investors focused on softer forward guidance and slower expected revenue growth.
